title: One & Done monster
description: A monster for the DM's Monster bank in One & Done, a grid-based tabletop game. Spawned monsters are independent copies, so editing a definition never changes monsters already in a game. All mechanics come from structured fields; `description` is a note for the DM and never drives mechanics. Rules: each round has a PLAYER PHASE and a DM PHASE. Hostile monsters act only in the DM PHASE, with `actions` actions (default 1) plus `movement` squares, which are separate. An action is one weapon attack or one ability. Attacks roll `attack` (always 1d20+N) against the target's Defense; on a hit, roll `damage`. A natural 20 is a crit (damage dice doubled), and a natural 1 always misses. Attacks and damaging abilities only work in combat. Monsters get no role bonuses, but heroes do: DPS heroes multiply their damage against monsters, tanks take reduced damage, and healers heal for more (a game setting from 1× to 5×, default 4×). Size maxHp with that in mind. Distances are grid squares (1 = adjacent).

id.description: Unique kebab-case id, e.g. "cave-troll". Must not clash with an existing monster id.

name.description: Display name. Spawned copies are numbered automatically ("Goblin 2").

image.description: Token image. Use the exact token path given in the request, e.g. "/static/tokens/monster_114.webp". If none is given, use the literal placeholder "/static/tokens/monster_NNN.webp" (the DM swaps in the real token later). Do not invent a numbered token. Large monsters scale the image to their `size`.

maxHp.description: Required unless `immortal`. Remember DPS heroes multiply their damage (default 4×). Typical: vermin 7–9, soldiers 13–16, brutes 50–60, bosses 120+.

defense.description: Number an attack roll must meet or beat to hit. Typical: 11 (lumbering) to 13 (most), 18 (armored boss).

movement.description: Squares per phase. In combat the DM's moves spend it (slows and snares reduce it; Shift-drag overrides). 0 = stationary. Typical 5–6, fast or flying 8.

actions.description: Actions per DM phase (default 1). Use 2 for bosses that make several attacks; 0 for things that never act (training dummies). The DM can always grant +1 action.

size.description: Footprint in squares. Leave out for normal 1×1 monsters; 2×2 for large (ogre), 3×3 for huge (dragon). Range is measured from the nearest edge.

hostile.description: Default true. false makes it side with the party: it can act in any phase without an action limit, players see its HP, and heroes' abilities treat it as an ally. Leave out for ordinary monsters.

immortal.description: true = a training-dummy-style target with no HP at all: damage is recorded but it can never be downed or killed (the DM can still remove it). Omit maxHp when true. Usually pair with actions 0 and movement 0.

attacks.description: Weapon attacks, one per action. Roster monsters have 1–3 (usually a melee and a ranged option). Empty only for things that never attack.

abilities.description: Optional special abilities (same effect engine as heroes). "enemy" targets are heroes and friendly NPCs; "ally" targets are other monsters.

items.description: Item id, kebab-case, e.g. "rusty-key". Ids that appear in data/items.json (e.g. "healing-potion") get that item's ability.

inventory.description: Optional loot or carried items. Only the DM sees a hostile monster's inventory.

description.description: Optional note for the DM (tactics, lore). Not shown to players and not used by the game.

dice.description: Dice expression: NdS terms (S is 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 or 20) and flat modifiers joined by + or -, e.g. "2d6+3", "1d8+1d6". No spaces.

attackRoll.description: A d20 roll with a flat modifier, e.g. "1d20+5". Typical monster modifiers are +4 (weak) to +10 (boss).

damageType.description: Optional. Everything except slashing/piercing/bludgeoning counts as magical (matters for magicalOnly protections). Leave out for plain physical attacks.

status.description: frightened: −2 to hit, and can't move closer to the caster (never stacks). snared: movement 0. shaken: −2 to hit. poisoned: −2 to hit for 5 rounds (ignores duration; refreshes, never stacks). slowed: label only (use modify_movement for a real slow).

label.description: Name shown on the token and in the feed. Defaults to the ability name.

when.description: Run this effect only if an earlier attack effect in the same ability hit (or missed).

duration.description: How long the effect lasts. current_turn: until this phase ends. until_next_player_phase. next_dm_phase: through the end of the next DM phase (the usual choice). combat: until combat ends. until_used: no time limit, removed when consumed. {"phases": N}: N phase transitions.

trigger.description: Consumes the effect the first time this happens. Most effects already have a sensible default; only set it to override.

damage.description: Typical: 1d4+2 (vermin) to 1d12+3 (brutes); bosses 2d10+6 or 6d6 breath weapons. Heroes take these as written (tanks take reduced damage).

range.description: 1 = melee. Reach 2 for big creatures; ranged attacks are typically 6–10.

ability.description: Effects run top to bottom. An ability needs at most one picked target: the first effect that targets enemy/ally/ally_or_self/cell decides what the DM picks. Monster abilities follow enemy rules: they can only be used during the DM PHASE, and each costs actions from the monster's per-phase allowance.

actionCost.description: Actions spent. 1 is normal; 0 means free (pair free abilities with usesPerPhase: 1 unless trivial).

range.description: Targeting range in squares; 0 for self/around-self abilities.

usesPerPhase.description: Max uses per combat phase. Required if any effect is grant_actions.

description.description: One DM-facing sentence that matches what the effects actually do.

effect.description: One step of an ability. `type` picks the shape. Target meanings: self; enemy / ally / ally_or_self = the creature the DM picks; cell = a square the DM picks; enemies_in_area / allies_in_area = everyone in a radius; hit_enemies = enemies hit by an earlier attack effect in this ability; checked_enemy = the subject inside roll_to_apply / dm_check outcomes. Omit `target` to use the default.

nestedEffects.description: Effects applied to the subject; target them at "checked_enemy" (or "self" for the caster).

effect_attack.description: One attack roll against the target's Defense, then damage on a hit.

range.description: Max distance in grid squares to the picked target. Usually equal to the ability range.

damage.description: Damage dice rolled on a hit, e.g. "2d8+2". A crit doubles the dice, not the modifier.

attackBonus.description: Flat bonus added to the attack roll. Usually leave out and put the bonus in `attack`.

defenseReduction.description: Treat the target's Defense as this much lower for this attack only.

damageBonus.description: Flat bonus added to the damage roll. Usually leave out and put it in `damage`.

effect_multi_attack.description: Several independent strikes on one target (each its own attack and damage roll). The ability pays actionCost once. Remaining strikes are lost if the target dies.

range.description: Max distance in grid squares to the picked target. Usually equal to the ability range.

damage.description: Damage dice rolled on a hit, e.g. "2d8+2". A crit doubles the dice, not the modifier.

attackBonus.description: Flat bonus added to the attack roll. Usually leave out and put the bonus in `attack`.

defenseReduction.description: Treat the target's Defense as this much lower for this attack only.

damageBonus.description: Flat bonus added to the damage roll. Usually leave out and put it in `damage`.

effect_area_attack.description: Every enemy within `radius` of the center gets its own attack roll and damage roll.

center.description: "self" = burst around the caster (set ability range 0). "target" = player picks an enemy within `range` and the burst centers on it. Default "self".

range.description: Max distance in grid squares to the picked target. Usually equal to the ability range.

damage.description: Damage dice rolled on a hit, e.g. "2d8+2". A crit doubles the dice, not the modifier.

attackBonus.description: Flat bonus added to the attack roll. Usually leave out and put the bonus in `attack`.

defenseReduction.description: Treat the target's Defense as this much lower for this attack only.

damageBonus.description: Flat bonus added to the damage roll. Usually leave out and put it in `damage`.

effect_chain_attack.description: Hits the picked enemy, then up to `jumps` more enemies the DM picks; each jump must be within `jumpRange` of the previous target, no repeats.

range.description: Max distance in grid squares to the picked target. Usually equal to the ability range.

damage.description: Damage dice rolled on a hit, e.g. "2d8+2". A crit doubles the dice, not the modifier.

attackBonus.description: Flat bonus added to the attack roll. Usually leave out and put the bonus in `attack`.

defenseReduction.description: Treat the target's Defense as this much lower for this attack only.

damageBonus.description: Flat bonus added to the damage roll. Usually leave out and put it in `damage`.

effect_heal.description: Rolls `heal` and restores that much HP (capped at max HP). Dead creatures cannot be healed.

target.description: "allies_in_area" heals every ally (and the caster) within `radius` of the caster.

range.description: Max distance in grid squares to the picked target. Usually equal to the ability range.

effect_chain_heal.description: Heals the picked ally, then up to `jumps` more wounded allies the DM picks, each within `jumpRange` of the previous one. Each heal is rolled separately.

range.description: Max distance in grid squares to the picked target. Usually equal to the ability range.

effect_modify_healing.description: The caster's next heal on the target gets +amount.

range.description: Max distance in grid squares to the picked target. Usually equal to the ability range.

effect_grant_protection.description: The holder's next incoming hit is reduced by `fraction` (default 0.5) or by a flat `amount`. Set one, not both.

magicalOnly.description: Only magical hits (fire, cold, lightning, …) are reduced.

range.description: Max distance in grid squares to the picked target. Usually equal to the ability range.

effect_absorb_next_hit.description: The holder's next incoming hit deals 0 damage.

range.description: Max distance in grid squares to the picked target. Usually equal to the ability range.

effect_redirect_next_hit.description: Placed on an ally: their next incoming hit lands on the caster instead.

range.description: Max distance in grid squares to the picked target. Usually equal to the ability range.

effect_defense_bonus.description: Defense modifier (negative = penalty). Default duration: until the next player phase.

radius.description: If set, also applies to every ally within this radius of the caster (the caster always gets it).

range.description: Max distance in grid squares to the picked target. Usually equal to the ability range.

effect_modify_damage_received.description: Changes the damage the holder takes from hits: +amount / ×multiplier. Set at least one.

effect_modify_damage_dealt.description: Changes the holder's next hit: +amount / ×multiplier (0.5 halves it). Set at least one. Default trigger next_hit. Default duration: a boost lasts until that hit lands; a penalty lasts through the next DM phase. It applies to every hit of the ability that uses it (all enemies of an area/chain attack, every strike of a multi-attack).

effect_modify_movement.description: Movement modifier. Negative values show as Slowed. Use duration "current_turn" for a self dash.

effect_taunt.description: While the taunter is a valid target, the taunted enemy's attacks must target the taunter.

radius.description: If set, taunts every enemy within this radius of the caster instead of one target.

effect_reduce_actions.description: Lowers the target's action allowance (never below 0). Default duration: next DM phase.

effect_mark_target.description: The caster's next hit on the target adds `bonus` damage dice.

range.description: Max distance in grid squares to the picked target. Usually equal to the ability range.

effect_grant_roll_bonus.description: Adds `bonus` to the holder's next attack or check roll.

bonus.description: Dice like "1d6" or a whole number.

range.description: Max distance in grid squares to the picked target. Usually equal to the ability range.

effect_apply_status.description: Applies a status. To affect a whole area, wrap this in roll_to_apply with a radius.

effect_remove_status.description: Removes every instance of a status from the target.

effect_discourage_attacks.description: Attacks against the holder take −penalty to hit.

range.description: Max distance in grid squares to the picked target. Usually equal to the ability range.

effect_grant_actions.description: Extra actions this phase. The ability MUST set usesPerPhase, and total granted ≤ actionCost + 1.

effect_teleport.description: Moves the caster to the square the DM picks, up to `distance` away. Set the ability range equal to distance.

effect_dash.description: Moves the caster on foot to the square the DM picks, up to `distance` away, without spending movement. Snared creatures can't dash, and frightened ones can't dash closer to what frightens them. Put a targeted effect after it (e.g. an attack with range 1) and the player then picks the target, measured from the new square. Set the ability range equal to distance.

effect_narrative.description: Records the use (and optional roll) in the feed; the DM decides the outcome. Use for utility/roleplay abilities with no mechanical effect.

effect_create_barrier.description: Places a temporary object token on the picked square. Visual cover only; the DM adjudicates.

effect_healing_aura.description: Places a totem on the picked square. At the start of each of the next `pulses` player phases it heals friendlies within `radius`.

effect_roll_to_apply.description: The CASTER rolls `roll` against each subject's Defense, like an attack (nat 20 always succeeds, nat 1 always fails). onSuccess runs when the caster's roll meets or beats the Defense, which is the same as the target failing to resist; onFailure runs when the target resists. This is NOT a D&D saving throw: there is no DC, no save roll by the target, and no `dc`, `onFail` or `onSave` field. Put the debuff in onSuccess. Use for debuffs that should be resistible.

radius.description: If set, every enemy within this radius of the caster is a subject (set ability range 0).

range.description: Max distance in grid squares to the picked target. Usually equal to the ability range.

onSuccess.description: Runs on each subject the caster's roll beat (the target failed to resist). Put the debuff here.

onFailure.description: Runs on each subject that resisted. Usually left out.

effect_dm_check.description: Rolls `roll` and creates a pending check; the DM clicks Success or Failure, which runs onSuccess/onFailure on the subject.

onSuccess.description: Runs if the DM rules the check a success for the caster.

onFailure.description: Runs if the DM rules the check a failure for the caster.
